mentions.name: fs_index
mentions.description: A local search engine tool that scans the home directory and indexes the data into OpenSearch so files on the laptop can be searched.
mentions.problem: Lacked a proper search engine for the laptop.
mentions.source_excerpt: I thought it might be fun to have a “proper” search engine for my laptop, so I wrote a thing (with my fingers! No Claude Code or codex here!) to scan my home directory and put data into OpenSearch so I can search stuff.

evidence.value: I thought it might be fun to have a “proper” search engine for my laptop, so I wrote a thing (with my fingers! No Claude Code or codex here!) to scan my home directory and put data into OpenSearch so I can search stuff.
